name: Sorcerer Tycoon
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Sorcerer Tycoon ! ⭐

Unlock different characters 🔥, fight against other players ⚔️, challenge powerful bosses and collect resources to improve yourself and finish your Tycoon! 💪

💾 Each Character has its own save file. Replay same character and keep your cursed energy and Yen to continue building tycoon.
💎 Rebirth tycoon to unlock new powerfull character and gain more stats and Yen!

💵 Join the group for +20% Yen and Cursed energy!
https://www.roblox.com/fr/groups/553189881

🎁 Codes: MRHAKARI, UPDATE5, JACKPOTS

🎮 Use G to Awakening on PC or press DPAD UP on console, on Mobile just TAP the button
